description: §18.5 block-body arm in a match VALUE-decl position (structured variant-arm path, the SILENT cousin). `const r = match t { .Low :> { const base = "co"; base + "ol" } .High :> { "warm" } }`. A variant block arm's tail expression must ASSIGN to the result var; pre-fix the shared bare-expr handler minted a FRESH `let _scrml_tilde_N = ...` under the active tildeContext, so the result var stayed null (silent-wrong — no error code, just a null value).
rationale: §18.5 block-arm value semantics apply to variant (structured-body) arms the same as literal arms: leading statements run, the tail expression is the arm value bound to the enclosing result var. Low -> "cool" (leading `const base` runs + tail `base + "ol"`), High -> "warm" (single-expression block). Pre-fix both returned null and rendered empty.
